title: Chapter 292: The Terrible Plague
content:
Chapter 292: The Terrible Plague

Just as the Zerg Sky Guard and Devourer were showing off their skills, the five-star Zerg transport host carried the Zerg Scorpion and Zerg Mammoth to the battlefield.

Wu Qing did not let the Zerg Scorpion and Zerg Mammoth participate in the battle. Now that the situation on the battlefield has stabilized, the Zerg only needs to lose Zerg puppies to kill a large number of the alien race's living forces. This is in the interests of the Zerg and does not need to be changed for the time being.

Up to now, the alien race has no longer sought to quickly eliminate the main combat arms of the Zerg, but has only increased its troops and fought with the Zerg army.

The number of the alien race's own army may be limited, but the troops of the alien race's affiliated races are not lacking at all.

With the status of the alien race as a super tribe in the evil god camp, the evil god camp army on the public battlefield of the entire southern theater is at their disposal.

Think about it from another perspective. If the Zerg can mobilize the troops of the local camp in the public battlefield of the entire southern theater, the main city of the 108th district will be stationed with so many troops. The total number of troops in the entire public battlefield can be imagined, which is an incredible number.

A small number of elite troops of the alien race, led by the armies of various affiliated races of the alien race, are constantly attacking the positions of the main combat arms of the Zerg army.

The Zerg destroyers with the highest efficiency in killing enemies, their firepower output is getting weaker and weaker as time goes by. Those Zerg destroyers with weaker strength are almost reaching their limit under the high-intensity firepower output and need to rest and recover.

The Zerg stealth spiders that have been lurking underground and constantly attacking with armor-piercing spikes are also slowing down their attack frequency.

The combat capabilities of the main combat arms, including the Zerg Cockroach, Zerg Hydralisk, Type II Zerg Toxic Ray Scorpion and Zerg Dragon, have all been declining from their peak state. Only the newly added troops can still output with the strongest firepower.

The combat capabilities of the two ultimate arms of the Zerg, one thousand five-star Zerg Sky Guards and one thousand five-star Zerg Devourers, are also declining.

This is the effect achieved by the alien army with countless lives.

Facing the endless alien army, the exhausted Zerg main combat arms must either improve their strength to enhance their combat power and restore their status, or continue to send reinforcements.

It is difficult for the Zerg to gain an advantage over the aliens at all costs by relying solely on the amazing Zerg puppies.

The battle between the Zerg army and the alien army continued. Before the main combat arms of the Zerg army did not suffer heavy casualties, Wu Qing chose to maintain this state.

The longer this state lasts, the better, the Zerg puppies are used to consume the alien army.

Therefore, in order to maintain this state, Wu Qing not only continuously replenished the Zerg Zerglings, but also the other main combat arms that suffered losses.

The main combat arms of the Zerg army slowly recovered to the number before the war. With these Zerg main combat arms, the Zerg army can continue to consume the alien army that has lost its ultra-long-range attack capability.

In this way, the war lasted until the night, and the reinforcements from the first Zerg sub-base could no longer rush to support, and the opportunity that the aliens had been waiting for finally came.

A large number of the alien troops on standby joined the attacking team. They were full of the blessing of the light magic, with dazzling white light, following countless friendly troops, and advancing towards the positions of the main combat arms of the Zerg army.

Above the battlefield, a large number of alien light griffins were thrown into the air battle battlefield, launching a fierce attack on the air force composed of Zerg dragons and Zerg devourers.

This was a counterattack carefully prepared by the aliens. The timing was very good. When the Zerg army was at its weakest, they attacked with all their might.

The aliens used solid elite troops to counterattack this time. No matter how many killing blows the Zerg army had, it would be useless. The two new types of soldiers with limited numbers would be powerless no matter how strong they were.

"The Zerg have no space transmission channel, so the reinforcements at night were affected. Let's see how they deal with the massive counterattack of the alien army!"

"The Zerg army can improve its strength at any time. I think they should deal with the powerful offensive of the alien army this night by improving their strength!"

"It's just night now, and they're starting to improve their strength. There's still a whole night. How are they going to fight?"

"What's more, it seems that the Zerg army needs to consume a lot of luck to improve its strength, and it can't be improved easily!"

"What we can think of, the aliens can definitely think of it. Let's see The aliens are determined to defeat the Zerg this time, otherwise their super tribe will lose face!"

"Haha, the aliens may not be able to defeat the Zerg in the public battlefield. Let's see if they will ask for help from their tribe!"

"It's also embarrassing for them to ask for help from their tribe!"

"After one night, the Zerg army that lost its reinforcements is still very dangerous. It depends on whether the Zerg has other ways to deal with it!"

"..."

The spectators from all forces in the local camp were a little worried about the Zerg army that lost its reinforcements.

One side has continuous reinforcements, while the other side has lost its back-up. If there is no effective response measures, the Zerg army may be defeated by the aliens in one night.

Wu Qing was of course prepared. First of all, the strength of the Zerg's main combat arms has been replenished to the number before the war.

The number of Zerg puppies and Type III Zerg poisonous ray scorpions has reached the highest density within the lord protection range of the 996 cities of the alien race. In other words, there is no place for Zerg puppies to stay if they are sent here.

The most important thing is that after a day of war, the system has accumulated a lot of resources, enough for Wu Qing to consume at will.

With resources, the Zerg has confidence. Relying on the existing Zerg forces on the battlefield, there are many ways to defeat the alien race.

…

Facing the powerful offensive of the alien race, Wu Qing did not choose to increase the strength of the Zerg army. He wanted to put the Zerg scorpions and Zerg mammoths into battle to test how much effect ten six-star Zerg scorpions and ten six-star Zerg mammoths can play on such a battlefield.

Wu Qing put the six-star ultimate arms such as Zerg scorpions and Zerg mammoths into battle, and there was also a reason to add points for the Zerg to gain the status of a large tribe.

The Zerg now needs to gain the status of a great clan in this world as soon as possible. After research and analysis, Wu Qing and the Queen of Zerg found that the status of this great clan is like a status in this world, which can bring huge benefits to the Zerg.

When the Zerg obtains the status of a great clan, the system may change.

The five-star Zerg transport host carrying ten six-star Zerg scorpions has flown to the flank of the main attack force of the alien army. Above the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous scorpions that are constantly attacking, a six-star Zerg scorpion is placed in turn at the ten positions selected by the Queen of Zerg.

Because of the super stealth ability of the five-star Zerg transport host, no one noticed their movements, allowing the ten six-star Zerg scorpions to mix in with the Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions at different positions.

The mixing of ten six-star Zerg scorpions in the vast sea of dogs did not attract any attention.

Ten six-star Zerg scorpions simultaneously released the plague to the alien army in the direction where the Zerg puppies were attacking.

The invisible plague spores fell into the alien army, spreading at a very fast speed, and quickly infected a large number of alien soldiers.

The plague spores ignored any defense of the alien soldiers and invaded their bodies, causing the soldiers who practiced light attribute energy and were not sick to become seriously ill in an instant.

They suddenly felt that the weapons in their hands became as heavy as a thousand pounds, and the armor on their bodies was like a mountain pressing on them.

They were breathing rapidly, dizzy, and unable to move, let alone continue to fight.

These symptoms varied according to their strength, but no one was immune.

The alien army that was attacking suddenly had ten areas of the army come to a standstill and lost their combat capability, which caused some chaos in the attacking alien army.

Those alien troops who were fighting against the Zerg puppies were infected with plague spores and were instantly killed by the Zerg puppies. The flank defense line of the alien attacking force was successfully broken through by the Zerg puppies.

The six-star Zerg scorpion mixed in the Zerg puppies and the three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpion, after releasing the plague, used the extermination ability to kill the alien army soldiers, and immediately restored its consumed energy and skill status while killing the enemy.

The six-star Zerg scorpion, which had recovered its energy and skill status, released the plague to the alien army again.

In this way, ten six-star Zerg scorpions quickly created ten huge plague areas in the alien attacking forces.

Plague spores can make weak enemies seriously ill and die, but this takes a certain amount of time. Those alien army soldiers infected with the plague still need Zerg puppies and three-type Zerg poisonous ray scorpions to kill them.

A large number of Zerg puppies rushed to these ten plague areas and quickly killed the alien army soldiers infected with the plague.

Another five five-star Zerg transport hosts flew to the ten plague areas and put down the ten six-star Zerg mammoths they were carrying one by one.

Ten huge six-star Zerg mammoths fell into the battlefield, and a terrible and fierce aura swept around, attracting a lot of attention.

No one knew what was going on with the plague spores released by the Zerg scorpions, but the changes in the plague zone had already attracted attention. Now that the six-star Zerg mammoths like ancient behemoths fell into the battlefield, it was hard not to attract attention.

The six-star Zerg mammoths that fell into the battlefield began to rampage, like a giant tank, crushing all enemies along the way.

And those alien human army soldiers who still had a certain combat power, all attacks were ineffective against the six-star Zerg mammoths, including long-range attacks such as crossbows shot from a distance, which could not hurt it at all.
